title: A founder's plan change is raised as ZOH's question, and the tester's tweak is what's saved
origin: #155, spec example "would 7:30 work better? / 8 would be better / 8 it is"

history.text: Two weeks straight, Maya. That's who you are now. Kalinixta 📚

plan.reason: Ten pages before sleep builds the habit without eating your night.

suggestions.reasoning: she mentioned falling asleep reading at 9

testerLines: 7:30 is tight with dinner, 8 would be better
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: a founder's plan change, accepted with a tweak.
shouldHaveHappened: The 9 am kickoff raises moving her reading to 7:30 pm as ZOH's own idea and asks if it would work for her (her call), never as already decided and with no mention of a team or founders; one question only. Her "8 would be better" gets a short confirmation that her reading is now at 8 pm, starting tonight, with no extra questions.
